scope: Implemented enhanced purchase/receipt-area rereading; observed new text for explicit review, no automatic financial corrections or complete-goal claim.

focused_source_observations.scope: Three default crops chosen for known errors on one familiar assistant-reviewed development receipt, not blind/representative accuracy or whole-receipt improvement.

controller.scope: Experimental single-browser resource guard, not a vendor requirement or guarantee of peak memory fit. Local synthetic input plus optional fixed receipt cohort. Observer is a sibling, process tree contains development tools and browser, not model-only memory or a phone measurement.

owned_tree_observation.scope: Peak sampled sum of the caller-selected owned root and observed descendants. A Node root includes its browser and native children; a Python worker root excludes its unrelated browser/Node parent. 250ms sampling can miss short-lived children. GPU and unrelated-process memory are excluded; per-process OS peaks are separate.
